purpose: Re-test the same 13 boundary cases after validator false-positive repairs and stronger proposition-level policy constraints.
v0_3_1_changes: Negated PPE safety statements no longer trigger false positives.
'No direct evidence...' no longer triggers the transport yes/no detector.
IBC/institutional guidance cannot be labelled as Malaysian law.
Old guidance cannot be declared current/applicable merely because a later sentence recommends verification.
Definitive legal Form E determinations are blocked when the task is only a likely-pathway assessment.
Form E completeness claims are rejected when missing_information is non-empty.
Cross-document consistency claims are rejected when missing_information is non-empty.
Policy prompts include explicit PROHIBITED and ALLOWED conclusion forms.
